mapper.sql: select shop_code, batchcode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, initialqty, remainingqty, purchaseprice, purchasecode, purchasedate, purchaseamount, owner_ordercode, owner_orderdetailcode, partnercode, partnername, productiondate, expiredate, case when closedflag = 0 then 'active' else 'closed' end as batchstatus, position, createtime from sdsshop.u_m_batchinfo
mapper.insert:
insert into sdsshop.u_m_batchinfo( shop_code, batchcode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, purchasecode, purchasedate, purchaseprice, purchaseamount, owner_ordercode, owner_orderdetailcode, initialqty, remainingqty, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, productiondate, expiredate, partnercode, partnername, closedflag, position, createtime, remark ) values( #{shopCode}, #{batchCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{purchaseCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{purchaseDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{costPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{purchaseAmount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{ownerOrderCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownerDetailCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{initQty}, #{remainQty}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, coalesce(#{qualityFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), coalesce(#{onhandFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), #{productDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{partnerCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{partnerName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, #{position, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate(), '' ) on duplicate key update goodsname = values(goodsname), spec = values(spec), unit = values(unit), warename = values(warename), purchaseprice = case when (remainingqty + values(remainingqty)) > 0 then (coalesce(purchaseprice, 0) * remainingqty + values(purchaseamount)) / (remainingqty + values(remainingqty)) else coalesce(values(purchaseprice), purchaseprice) end, purchaseamount = purchaseamount + values(purchaseamount), initialqty = initialqty + values(initialqty), remainingqty = remainingqty + values(remainingqty), productiondate = coalesce(values(productiondate), productiondate), expiredate = coalesce(values(expiredate), expiredate), partnercode = coalesce(values(partnercode), partnercode), partnername = coalesce(values(partnername), partnername),
position = coalesce(position, values(position)),
owner_ordercode = coalesce(owner_ordercode, values(owner_ordercode)), owner_orderdetailcode = coalesce(owner_orderdetailcode, values(owner_orderdetailcode)), closedflag = 0
mapper.select: where shop_code = #{shopCode} and owner_orderdetailcode = #{ownerDetailCode} order by createtime desc, batchcode
